slides.title: Customers leave your website in
slides.body: Here are the 5 reasons why — and how to fix each one.

slides.title: It loads too slowly
slides.body: Many visitors leave if a page takes more than about 3 seconds on a phone.
slides.fix: Compress images, use good hosting and remove heavy plugins.

slides.title: It's hard to use on a phone
slides.body: Most visitors come from mobile. Tiny text and tiny buttons make them leave.
slides.fix: Open your site on your own phone today. Can you tap every button with your thumb?

slides.title: They can't tell what you do
slides.body: If the first screen only says "Welcome", visitors are confused and go back.
slides.fix: One clear line: what you sell + who it's for + where.

slides.title: No easy way to contact you
slides.body: No WhatsApp button, no phone number, and the form is hidden at the bottom.
slides.fix: Add a WhatsApp or call button that is always visible.

slides.title: It looks old or untrusted
slides.body: Old design, broken links, no real photos and no proof of work.
slides.fix: Real photos, a clean layout and real proof: your work, reviews and years in business.

slides.title: Quick check for your website
items: Has a WhatsApp or call button

slides.title: Not sure how your site scores?
slides.body: We'll send you a free 2-minute video review of your website.
